name: LAI-01 Calculate Opportunity Score
trigger: Dataverse child flow called from Copilot or portfolio app
actions: Validate eight ratings are integers from 1 to 5
Apply forced Governance Review when Risk equals 5
Apply forced Discovery Required when Feasibility is 1 or 2
Calculate expected annual hours and optional financial value
Update PriorityScore PriorityBand benefit fields and formula version
Return score band components and benefit estimates
exceptions: Missing or invalid rating: mark Scoring Failed and notify owner
Dataverse write conflict: retry with exponential policy then create support event
security: Run-only users provide no connections; owner uses governed connection reference
